title: The positive connecting arrow in an arbitrary abelian category
statement: In an abelian category C with its derived category, for any short complex s and proof hs of short exactness, positiveExactBoundary s hs is the connecting arrow hs.singleδ shifted once, followed by the inverse shift-addition comparison from shift one then shift one to shift two. Its source is single(s.X3)[1] and target single(s.X1)[2].

source.place: clause (2), evaluation gives the finite Kummer first Chern class; expanded SmoothPurityTowerClasses proof, steps 5--8

proof.text: Construct the actual morphism by composing hs.singleδ shifted by one with shiftFunctorAdd(C derived, 1, 1).inv on single(s.X1). The usual derived category has the required integer shift. All category witnesses remain parameters of the construction.

proof_origin.place: clause (2), exact evaluation of the integral Kummer composite

def positiveExactBoundary {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} C] (s : ShortComplex C) (hs : s.ShortExact) :
    ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj s.X₃)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj s.X₁)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧
